content: In particular, we analyzed how the attention heads in the proposed adaptively sparse Transformer can specialize more and with higher confidence. Our adaptivity strategy relies only on gradient-based optimization, side-stepping costly per-head hyper-parameter searches. Further speed-ups are possible by leveraging more parallelism in the bisection algorithm for computing $\alpha $-entmax.
